checks.traceability: every method claim links to a full-read source span or an explicitly labelled ungrounded default
checks.falsifiability: null, mechanism, observable falsifier, and stopping rule are nonempty and machine-readable
checks.comparability: baseline, treatment difference, task, scorer, seed policy, and maximum resource budget are identical except declared factors
checks.legality: licence, data access, privacy, oracle isolation, and human authority checks all pass
checks.budget: worst-case projected cost including contingency is within the human-approved envelope
checks.executability: clean-environment Stage 0 fixtures and task/scorer/environment certification all pass

decision_rule.ADMIT: all six checks pass; for C1 exactly two frozen, independently generated, mechanism-distinct candidates exist; deterministic tie-break selects one and records the rejected alternative
decision_rule.REVISE: one or more failed checks are correctable without observing hidden scorer outcomes, changing the task split, or changing a frozen factor; emit the exact failed checks and allow one pre-budget revision
decision_rule.BLOCK: any legality/oracle/provenance failure, environment/scorer failure, unapproved worst-case budget, fewer than 12 confirmatory tasks, or a correction that would require outcome visibility

admission_rule.selection_rule: among ADMIT-eligible candidates, maximize preregistered expected information gain per conservative projected dollar; tie-break by lower worst-case cost, then lexicographic candidate ID
admission_rule.fail_closed: missing or unparsable fields are failures; no model critic can override the predicate

nodes.summary: G×C×F 설계·문헌·사전등록의 가변 연구 상태

POPPER PMLR/arXiv primary source, fully read for sequential-falsification validity boundaries
main null must imply every null sub-hypothesis; relevance is a validity precondition
each e-value must be conditionally valid given prior information; unused data cannot influence test selection
termination must be a stopping time and cumulative evidence is an e-process
failed execution is recorded and skipped rather than converted into inferential evidence
POPPER supplies conditions for sequential statistical validity but does not establish efficacy or Type-I control for ARGO F
ResearchAgent NAACL primary source, fully read for factor C prior-art and non-transfer boundaries
research idea is decomposed into problem, method, and experiment design stages
one ResearchAgent iteratively revises separate idea parts from ReviewingAgent feedback
no ground-truth open-ended idea answer; evaluation combines LLM and expert judgments
ResearchAgent supplies staged idea/reviewer prior art but not independent candidates, deterministic admission, or C efficacy
PaperQA2 primary source, fully read for Stage R metric and reproducibility boundaries
LitQA2 defines precision among answered, accuracy over all, DOI attribution recall, and explicit abstention
DOI recall is reported at search, top-k, RCS, and final attribution stages
agent/search/traversal/RCS/context depth affect recall, precision and accuracy differently; smaller RCS models can hurt
open package lacks full-text search and citation traversal used in study; bespoke server adds persistence and measurement infrastructure
Stage R must separate answer precision/accuracy/source recall and bind actual retrieval infrastructure; PaperQA2 does not establish local adapter efficacy
OpenScholar primary source, fully read for Stage R corpus, factor-separation, citation and evaluator boundaries
v3 corpus runs through Oct 2024, but evaluation uses v2 through Jan 2023 due benchmark/model timing
candidate passages combine frozen datastore, Semantic Scholar API, and web retrieval
self-feedback adds retrieval/refinement/citation verification and is distinct from retrieval itself
heuristic weights, rubric gaming, adjacent-citation strictness, annotation cutoff and domain limits
Stage R must freeze corpus bytes and vary retrieval alone; combined self-feedback results and weak judge agreement do not identify local retrieval benefit
W3C PROV-DM/O official Recommendations
RO-Crate peer-reviewed primary paper
entity, activity, generation and usage core definitions
a named provenance bundle is itself an entity, enabling provenance of provenance
self-described Root Data Entity and minimal metadata requirements in JSON-LD
domain profiles constrain expectations; detailed W3C PROV bundles may coexist as data entities
PROV and RO-Crate support generic provenance interchange and packaging but not ARGO admissibility, causal validity, or G efficacy
RE-Bench canonical report, fully read for Stage 1 unit, budget, scaffold, floor/ceiling and transfer boundaries
timestamped scorer, starting and hidden reference solution, normalized continuous score
best-of-k outcome depends on allocating fixed total time among independent runs
two scaffolds and wall-clock budgets define treatment surface; API pauses excluded from time
short scope, seven environments, rare-success noise, scaffold effects and visible test-score overfitting limit transfer
Stage 1 uses task-level mean ITT under fixed scaffold/resource/score visibility; best-of-k and short ML task scores do not establish long-horizon R&D efficacy
Stage 0 13-category 49-fixture acceptance specification; meta-validated but runner not certified
Canonical protocol fingerprint schema/template; binding-valid but blocked with unresolved fields and no fingerprint
